reviews.title: Crazy good value
reviews.comment: This case is top notch. I transferred everything from a musetex case and difference is night and day. Way more of a premium feel for a similar price point. Plenty of room in the back and beneath the case to build. Loving it so far. It looks amazing with my components. Cable management was also super easy.
reviews.author: Jared Henderson

reviews.title: I'm impressed!
reviews.comment: Quite the epic case. It is very large but looks stunning. RGB accent lighting. Gpu anti sag brace included. Extra hardware with an organizer. I have always enjoyed this brand. While others cheap out in quality, this company continues to release high quality products. This case is a steal at it's price. The panels measure around 0.85mm in thickness. It's heavy. None of that cheap flimsy crap you seem in most cases that use 0.45mm steel, so low risk to damage. Great for reusing through several builds. I'm impressed. My only complaint is I wish they had a slightly smaller version of this same design.
reviews.author: John B

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.comment: Everything arrived good and well. No damage from shipping so it was well packaged specially traveling so far away and  a place knowed for damaging packagages. Im very happy with the quality of product it have smooth metal edge the case feels strong, the case glass feels soo good to pull out giving amazing large space to work with. the wires for the front panel is one singular connection which is perfect no need hasle and what amazed me also is that the cable came white if you order it white which comes perefectly with the theame of the build. Overall im happy with my purchase
reviews.author: Kim

reviews.title: Beautiful case
reviews.comment: Very nice case, easy to build in. Plenty of holes for cable management. Airflow seems good for a budget case. Front and side glass panels give this case a very modern look.
